---
title: "Operators"
---

::: {layout-ncol="2"}
|     | Arithmetic     |
|:---:|----------------|
| \+  | Addition       |
| \-  | Subtraction    |
| \*  | Multiplication |
|  /  | Division       |
| \^  | Exponent       |

|     | Relational               |
|:---:|--------------------------|
| \>  | Greater Than             |
| \>= | Greater Than or Equal to |
| \<  | Less Than                |
| \<= | Less Than or Equal to    |
| ==  | Equal                    |
| !=  | Not Equal                |

:::
